relevant_changes: Methods for measuring electric storage water-heater performance for household purposes.
Does not apply to storage water heaters that use electricity as a secondary source of heating the water.
Does not specify product safety; safety is separately addressed by IEC 60335-1 with IEC 60335-2-21.
Evaluates annual solar water-heater energy performance using component tests plus a mathematical model.
Scope includes solar water heaters with integral backup or preheating into a conventional storage or instantaneous water heater.
Does not provide product design or operation requirements.
Outdoor test methods for performance characterization and yearly prediction of solar-only domestic water-heating systems.
ISO/AWI 9459-2 Edition 2 was registered in September 2026 and will replace the 1995 edition when published; do not describe the work item as a published standard.

research_targets.functional_unit: one matched Eco-equivalent full-load service with all prescribed independent item endpoints passed
research_targets.caveat: These are arithmetic comparisons between declared source values and aspirational targets only. Programmes, standard editions, load protocols, reference detergent, endpoints, market revisions and measurement boundaries are not yet matched.
